entities.summary: Tope Alabi is a Nigerian gospel singer, film music composer and actress. She is also known as Ore ti o common and as Agbo Jesu. can be described as one of the pacesetters of soundtracks in the Yoruba film industry and has composed over 350 soundtracks credited to her name till date. Tope Alabi obtained a Higher National Diploma in Mass communication from the Polytechnic of Ibadan, after graduating in 1990, she worked as a correspondent at NTA in Ibadan. She started singing at a younger age, when she joined the choir in her local Catholic Church at the age of seven.
